Avoid life mods on chest until you can get a really, really good one.

If Jack somehow becomes expensive, jagged fossil crafting or reforge phys in harvest bench has you covered

		^xFFFF77---------- EXTREMELY IMPORTANT INFO ----------

^x70FF70-Leaguestart Regex^7 
Copy the code below and paste it into Tarkleigh's search bar in Lioneye's Watch to highlight useful 3-link items:

g-g-b|g-[gb]-g|b-g-g|Runn|rint

^x70FF70-Area of Effect
^7You need between 37-43% Increased Area of Effect to make all five of your ^x70FF70Toxic Rain^7 pods cleanly overlap. You get 20% from the Passive Skill Tree, and the rest from a combination of helm and gloves prefixes. 
You can also get Area of Effect as a corrupted belt implicit or a corrupted jewel implicit.

You don't need to worry about AoE during the campaign.

^x70FF70-Should I do the Siosa quest? (A3 Library)^7
You don't have to, and it is out of the way, but it lets you buy ^x7070FFFlame Dash^7 and ^x7070FFMalevolence^7 before Act 6, so yeah.

^x70FF70-How to Fix Mana in the Campaign^7
Make a beeline to Primal Spirit in Act 1. Use ^x7070FFClarity^7 once it becomes available in Act 1. 

Don't overlevel ^x7070FFClarity^7, the mana reservation cost gets big pretty quickly. Level 5 or 6 is a good stopping point.

Use your mana flask liberally, and spec toward Thrill of Battle on the right-hand side of the tree.

^x70FF70-Fixing Mana at Endgame^7
Craft ^x8888FF-7 Mana Cost of Non-Channeling Skills^7 prefixes on your rings and amulet.
The ^xE05030Searing Exarch^7's helm implicit modifier ^x8888FFX% Reduced Mana Cost of Attacks^7 is also important. Getting a high rank of that implicit by using ^xAF6025Orbs of Conflict^7 is really important for fixing mana at higher gear levels.

^xAF6025^x70FF70^x70FF70-How should I use Immortal Call & Withering Step? Is Automation Support the play?^7
Yeah, it's really good!

^x70FF70^x70FF70^x70FF70^x70FF70-What is the best anointment?^7
^xD02090Potency of Will^7.

^x70FF70-What kind of flasks should I use?^7
^xE05030Life^7 Flask is a given. You want a prefix that grants Increased Life Recovered and Reduced Recovery Rate so that you don't have to hit the keybind as often to keep it active. 

I bind my life flask to my mouse. 10/10, would recommend.

Make sure your ^xE05030Life^7 Flask has a "^x8888FFGrants Immunity to X^7" Suffix. ^xE05030Bleed^7/^xE05030Corrupted Blood^7 immunity is best. This will allow you to drink it even while at full health.
^xE05030
Ruby^7, ^x3F6DB3Sapphire^7, and ^xADAA47Topaz^7 flasks all work well in this build. 
They help fix resistances early on, and overcapping your ^x3F6DB3Cold^7 and ^xADAA47Lightning^7 Resistances so that you can safely farm ^x3F6DB3Blue Eldritch Altars^7 is a safe move.
^x70FF70Jade^7 and ^x8888FFQuartz^7 Flasks are decent options during the campaign.

^7Silver^7^7 adds both movement speed and attack speed. It's a no-brainer.
Quicksilver adds movement speed. It's not required, but it's pretty close.

^xD02090Progenesis^7 far outperforms the competition, but it is expensive.


^x70FF70-What is the best flask prefix?^7
Increased Charge Recovery will provide the most uptime on utility flasks. 
Increased Flask Duration and Reduced Charges Used are both decent. They're not as good, but not bad, either.

For ^xE05030Life^7 Flasks, as mentioned above: Increased Life Recovered and Reduced Recovery Rate is a mandatory prefix.

Once you have ^xAF6025The Tides of Time^7, you can use Increased Flask Effect, Reduced Duration as a Prefix on some flasks and still maintain 100% uptime.

^x70FF70-Which flask suffixes are important?^7
^x8888FF% Chance to Avoid Being Stunned^7 will prevent you from being stunlocked to death.
^x8888FF% Reduced Effect of Curses^7 is great for QoL.
^x8888FF% Chance to Avoid Being Shocked^7 is excellent for becoming Elemental Ailment immune if using ^xAF6025Stormshroud^7.
^x8888FF% Increased Evasion Rating^7 is good defensively.

You can also benchcraft Rarity, which will result in better drops and significantly more gold from monsters.

^x70FF70-Which tattoos should I use?^7
The ^x70FF70Tattoo of the Tawhoa Herbalist^7 replaces ^x70FF70Dexterity^7 small passive nodes and grants 4% increased Flask Effect Duration. 
This isn't mandatory, but it is *VERY* good. You can use other tattoos to solve problems in your gear, but no others are this generically useful.

^x70FF70-Is ^7^xAF6025The Tides of Time^7 ^x70FF70belt from Uber Shaper good?^7
It is. 
It easily grants permanent flask uptime and significant increased flask effect, enough to outperform even the juiciest rare flask belts, and unlike a ^xAF6025Mageblood^7, it applies to ^xAF6025Unique^7 flasks.
When combined with ^xAF6025Progenesis^7, this provides far more defensive value than any other unique in the game can offer.
You can push into the 300+ Life/sec range with ^xAF6025The Tides of Time^7 equipped. That's a preposterous amount of life regen.

It does come from an Uber Pinnacle boss, but Uber Shaper is generally regarded as the easiest Uber boss, and the droprate was fairly high during Patch 3.24.

The implicit modifier is not great, so there's a real incentive to double-corrupt it and try to get attack speed or skill effect duration.

^x70FF70

^xFFFF77---------- LEAGUE START INFO ----------^7

^x70FF70-What skill should I use in Act 1?^7
^7^x70FF70Caustic Arrow^7 is very good for most of Act 1.
Its main source of damage is the pool it leaves on the ground, and it doesn't overlap, so you don't have to spam it on bosses.
^x70FF70Puncture^7 helps a lot on Brutus. That is its only use.

Swap to ^x70FF70Toxic Rain^7 at level 12. You can continue using ^x70FF70Caustic Arrow^7 against Merveil if you have a socket for it. 
If you manage to maintain a couple of 3-link setups throughout the campaign, you can continue using ^x70FF70Caustic Arrow^7 with ^x70FF70Arrow Nova Support^7 and ^x70FF70Pierce Support^7, just like you would at endgame.

This is not mandatory, it's just an option that can give you the feel of playing the endgame build during the campaign.

^xD02090I greatly prefer the two-button playstyle, which is not something I can say about literally any other build.^7

^x70FF70-Early Leveling Tips:^7
Look for movement speed boots, quicksilver flasks, and 3 ^x70FF70green^7-link items.
Don't waste time killing ^xFFFF77rares^7 unless you can do so really efficiently. 
Focus on killing ^x8888FFmagic^7 packs for XP and ^xC8C8C8white^7 mobs to keep your flasks full. 
Keep moving! Leveling in Path of Exile involves a lot of walking!

Get a ^x3F6DB3Sapphire Ring^7 (or two) before fighting Merveil.

Finding a 4-link is your first big gearing goal (level 25+).
You either want 4^x70FF70g^7 or 3^x70FF70g^71^x7070FFb^7. Use ^x7070FFEfficacy^7 as your ^x7070FFBlue^7 Support Gem.
3^x70FF70g^71^xE05030r^7 or 2^x70FF70g^71^x7070FFb^71^xE05030r^7 can work, but it's not as good. Use ^xE05030More Duration Support^7 or ^xE05030Damage on Full Life Support^7 as your Red Support Gem.

^x8888FFNOTE:^7 If using ^xE05030Damage on Full Life Support^7, be sure to take the Life Mastery that grants "You count as on Full Life while at 90% maximum health or above."

^x70FF70-Auras^7
^x7070FFClarity^7. It's free mana regen. Pick it up at level 10, use it throughout the entire campaign. Don't overlevel it. Anywhere in the level 5-8 range is a good stopping point.

^x70FF70^x7070FFSummon Skitterbots^7^7 is the best aura available when it becomes available early in Act 2, but it quickly drops in value compared to alternatives like those listed below. 
   (Use it for a while, but be prepared to drop it when the time comes. Continue leveling it in your offhand.)

^x70FF70Haste^7^7 is the best aura in the campaign because it makes you move faster. It's not amazing for fighting bosses.

Switch to ^x7070FFMalevolence^7 for more single-target damage.

^x7070FFPurity of Elements^7 helps with capping resists and being ailment immune.
^x70FF70
Grace^7 is a great defensive aura, and you can use it to massively increase your tankiness if you find yourself struggling defensively at any point.
It's mainly just for not dying to random packs of ^x8888FFmagic^7 and ^xFFFF77rare^7 monsters, which is very useful, but swapping auras during the campaign will make the experience faster and smoother.
^x70FF70Grace^7 won't make you faster or add damage, and it's mostly worthless against most bosses. 


^xFFFF77---------- EARLY ENDGAME ----------^7

^x70FF70-Kitava's dead. What now?^7
Level up in ^xE05030Blood Aqueducts^7 or ^xD02090The Quarry^7 until you are around level 68.
Start progressing your atlas.
Farm currency in easy content. Your damage will suck a bit, but you are super fast, so Heist is perfect.
This build is outstanding for Labrunning, if you're willing to do it.

Farming Alva & Bestiary^7 in low-tier white maps is a really strong, easy strategy early in a league.
Alch-and-Go Expedition^7^7^7 Farming is great, too.
Betrayal is a profitable league mechanic early, and it can create some really useful gear at leaguestart.
I usually farm Betrayal and Expedition at league start, since they both provide gear and Expedition gives a lot of bubblegum currency.

I'm also a big fan of Essences, although they are a little more annoying to set up and run at league start now that they require ^xFFFF77T6+^7 maps in order to maximize their value.

Try to get a ^xAF6025Quill Rain^7 or a 6-link Short Bow from ^xAF6025The Porcupine^7 Divination Cards. This will help your damage out a lot!
Craft the Short Bow using ^xD02090Shrieking Essence of Dread^7 for +2 bow gems. Craft Attack Speed, or Chaos DoT Multi if you get Attack Speed on the bow.

Farming Betrayal for ^xAF6025Devouring Diadem^7 from Catarina can be really valuable.

Get a ^xAF6025Kintsugi^7 as soon as you can, it will substantially improve your overall tankiness.

^xAF6025Lightning Coil^7 has been a popular chest option in the past, and it's still good, but the downside of -60 Lightning Resistance is pretty brutal. It's more reliable than ^xAF6025Kintsugi^7 is at high gear levels, but early on it's not as good.

Fix your stats, get your flasks set up, keep your resistances up, level your gems, and start saving to craft a +3 ^x70FF70Thicket Bow^7 & buy an ^xE05030Empower Support^7.


^xFFFF77---------- ENDGAME FAQ ----------^7

^x70FF70-What Map Mods Should I Avoid?^7
^x8888FFLess Recovery Rate of Life & ES^7 and ^x8888FFPlayers Gain Reduced Flask Charges^7 are the only mods you absolutely want to avoid. 

Everything else is playable, but some combinations can be annoying or dangerous.

^x70FF70-What Cluster Jewels Should I Use?^7
^xC8C8C8^7Large ^xD02090Chaos^7 ^xD02090Damage^7 Cluster Jewels with 8 mods. The preferred notables are ^xD02090Unholy Grace^7, ^xD02090Unwaveringly Evil^7, and ^xD02090Wicked Pall^7.

Medium ^x70FF70Projectile Damage^7 Cluster Jewels with ^xFFFF77Shrieking Bolts^7 and ^xFFFF77Repeater^7 are the best option for maximizing damage.

Medium ^xD02090Chaos Damage^7 Over Time Cluster Jewels with ^xD02090Wicked Pall^7 and ^xD02090Student of Decay^7 are a good alternative that can help with ^xD02090Chaos Resistance^7. The difference in damage is pretty small.

^x70FF70^x70FF70^x70FF70-Do I need specific Jewels?^7
Nope! Jewels and Rare gear are about solving problems. You need a certain amount of resistances, stats, and spell suppression to make the build function safely.
Acquire them across all those pieces of gear as you are able.

^x70FF70-Is the Thread of Hope necessary?^7
No, but it is a potential endgame optimization that lets you anoint ^xFFFF77Sovereignty^7 without losing the massive damage from ^xFFFF77Potency of Will^7.

-^x70FF70Do you need a Despair curse-on-hit ring?^7
No, but it's convenient! Many players self-cast ^xD02090Despair^7 on rares and bosses, but that's tedious.

^x70FF70-Do I need Forbidden Flesh/Flame?^7
No! They're a super expensive flex, and a really bad investment unless you can get lucky and buy them cheap.
They do add a lot of damage/speed, though!

^x70FF70-What Watcher's Eye mods should I use?^7
^x8888FFPhasing while Haste is Active^7 is pretty good, and surprisingly cheap. You can get Phasing elsewhere, but this is a really easy spot for it that costs very little.
^x8888FF^x8888FFIncreased Damage Over Time Multiplier While Affected By Malevolence^7 adds a ton of damage, which is great, but it is insanely expensive with other useful mods. 
If you are trying to transition out of using Eldritch Battery, using a ^xAF6025Watcher's Eye^7 that grants ^x8888FFNon-Channelling Skills have -(10-5) to Total Mana Cost while affected by Clarity^7 is extremely useful for fixing mana costs, but beware, it can be expensive!

^x70FF70-Why not use Headhunter?^7
^xAF6025The Tides of Time^7, mostly. It just outclasses every other option in the belt slot for Pathfinder builds, and it's not really even close.

^xAF6025Headhunter^7 is very fun, but since this build deals ^xD02090Chaos DoT^7 instead of ^xC8C8C8physical^7 or ^xFFFF77elemental^7 damage, it's not quite as good as it is for normal bow builds like ^x70FF70Lightning Arrow^7.
^xAF6025
^xAF6025Headhunter^7 can add tons of projectiles and attack speed, which may make the game perform poorly if using ^x70FF70Toxic Rain^7 MTX.

^x70FF70-Why not run Defiance of Destiny?^7
Damage! A +2 neck grants ~25% more damage than a ^xAF6025Defiance of Destiny^7.
^xAF6025Defiance of Destiny^7 is a great amulet. It will make you UNREASONABLY tanky, and it is much cheaper, it just comes at the expense of some damage.
It also makes fixing mana more difficult.

^x70FF70-Why not all 3 Ele Res Flasks?^7
Same reason! It's a super-tanky setup that works great, but you have to give up some damage & speed for it! No thanks!

^x70FF70-Do I really need to use a ^xE05030Life^7 ^x70FF70Flask?^7^7
^xAF6025Defiance of Destiny^7 is a decent alternative, but you will need to account for DoT effects and find another way to deal with ^xE05030Bleed^7 & ^xE05030Corrupted Blood^7.
If you choose to not run a ^xE05030Life^7 Flask, ^xAF6025The Tides of Time^7 loses a ton of value, as well. This is more of an argument to just stick with a ^xE05030Life^7 Flask than it is to not use ^xAF6025The Tides of Time^7.
^xE05030Corrupted Blood^7 immunity through Corrupted Jewels will work, but for ^xE05030Bleed^7 you will probably want to run ^xE05030Steelskin^7 instead of ^xE05030Immortal Call^7 or switch to Ralakesh for your Minor Pantheon.

	<Notes>
		^xB97123
^xFFFF77Hello ma boy,^7 ^x70FF70this is the latest "HOW TO LEAGUE START WITH MY (DIRECT HIT DAMAGE!) Explosive Arrow Ballista" Guide^7.  

For the actual ^xFFFF77(DIRECT HIT DAMAGE!) Explosive Arrow Ballista^7 Build Guide you will need to click here: 

https://www.poe-vault.com/guides/explosive-arrow-ballista-hierophant-build-guide

^xD02090*THE BUILD GUIDE CONTAINS TONS OF USEFUL INFORMATION. 99% of your questions are already answered there!!.^7^7 (This "INFO" page only covers the league-start progression.)
If this is your first time playing the build, please don't skip the written guide.

^xFFFF77^xD02090Full Campaign Showcase with explanations of each transition phase and multiple tips and tricks here:^7^7
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dELaqlYiiWI

^xB97123[READ!]^7 FOR THE CAMPAIGN & EARLY MAPPING: Do not stress too much regarding your items. I've adapted this starter to be as lazy & simple as possible!
For the most part, you will use generic items found on the ground, purchased from vendors, or acquired through trade (life, resistances, attack speed, elemental damage etc.). There are also some specific item recommendations under each section below.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________

ACTs 1  - 3 ^xD02090( TREE: Use Act 1 - 3 LEVELING [HF TOTEM] )^7
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________

First Town. buy ^x8888FFPurifying Flame ^xC8C8C8( complete quest ^xFFFF77Breaking some Eggs.^xC8C8C8 go back to town. )

Buy ^xE05030Holy Flame Totem. ^xC8C8C8This will be your main skills till you reach act 3 (Library). then transition/swap to^x70FF70 Explosive arrow ballista.^7

Main setup:- 

- ^x8888FFPurifying Flame ^xC8C8C8( YOU DROP THIS SKILL GEM WHEN YOU GET THE ^xB97123"ANCESTRAL BOND" KEYSTONE^7, refer to "Tree" & "Skills" from the POB )^7
^xE05030- Holy Flame Totem ^x8888FF+ Combustion support + Infused Channeling
^xE05030- Flame Wall^7 ( when projectiles pass through these walls they gain added fire damage; you can summon 3 Walls at a time! )

^xC8C8C8^7Utility:-^7

- ^x8888FFFrost Blink^xC8C8C8
^xE05030- Flammability^7 ( Curse the enemies with Flammability so you deal more damage )

^xC8C8C8^7Auras:-^7

- ^x8888FFClarity
- ^xE05030Herald of Ash

^7TIPS:
It's okay to have low-quality items in the early Acts!
In Acts I - III, items with multiple links and sockets are more valuable than raw stats.
You will want to use two sceptres or two wands. We will not use a shield in this phase.
When picking up gear in Acts I-III, look for stats that boost your damage, such as:
- % increased spell damage
- % increased fire damage
- +# to Level of all Fire Skill Gems
- Adds # to # Fire Damage to Spells

*You can gamble for weapon upgrades with the gold that you find. Each town has a vendor that gives you an option to gamble.

BANDIT QUEST: Kill All.
		
^7_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________^7

^xC8C8C8^7ACT 3 - 10^7 + Early mapping (white and yellow maps) ^xD02090( TREE: Use Act 3 - 10 LEVELING [EA BALLISTA] )^7^7
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________

^7Once you reach the Library, you should be buying this setup for next Acts and early mapping till you hit level 78 aprox.^7

You will need to level up your gems after you buy them. For that -> Go to "The Docks" (area in act III) and kill some monsters there. 
You will continue with the campagn once Explosive Arrow reaches level 2

Main Setup:

^x70FF70- Explosive Arrow
^xE05030- Ballista Totem Support
- Elemental Damage with Attacks
^x70FF70- Lesser Multiple Projectiles ^7(when you find a 4-link item; HELPS A LOT WITH THE MONSTER CLEARS )

Utility:-^7

- ^x8888FFFrost Blink^xC8C8C8
- ^xE05030Steelskin^7 + ^x8888FFAutomation^7
^7-^7 ^x70FF70Frenzy + Manaforged arrows + Mirage Archer (Optional) + Culling Strike (Optional)
^xE05030- Flammability^7^7 ( Curse the enemies with Flammability so you deal more damage )

^xC8C8C8^7Auras:-^7

- ^x8888FFClarity
- ^xE05030^x70FF70Precision^7 ( [READ!]after completing the campign swap ^x70FF70Precision^7^7 ^7with ^x8888FFPurity of Elements)

^7TIPS:-
1) CHECK VENDORS for a 4 link with 2 green & 2 red  // else go on the TRADE WEBSITE and buy an item with these links! ( should be very cheap on trade ). You can also GAMBLE a Body Armour with Armour and Evasion in Act 3.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          FOR LINKED ITEMS.
2) DO NOT WEAR A QUIVER THAT HAS *PIERCE EFFECTS*^7 ( AVOID the ^xFFFF77PENETRATING QUIVER^7 base as it will nerf your damage srastically!!! )
4) COMPLETE THE 3 LABS BEFORE MAPPING.
					Recommended:- 
								a) first lab - before killing Daresso and Kaom ( allocate pursuit of faith )
								b) second lab - Do it somewhere in the middle of Act Act 8 (allocate Ritual of Awakening)
								c) third lab - before you kill Kitava in ACT 10. (allocate convication of power ) 

// for the rare items ( Explosive Arrow Ballista phase ) look for:^x70FF70 ^xFFFF77ATTACK SPEED, INCREASED ELEMENTAL DAMAGE WITH ATTACKS & INCREASED FIRE DAMAGE^7^7
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________

^xC8C8C8^7^x70FF70SWAP TO THE "ENDGAME SETUP" somewhere in late red maps. Open the Written Build Guide and you have everything that you need: ^7(LINK: https://www.poe-vault.com/guides/explosive-arrow-ballista-hierophant-build-guide )^7
Before that you can use these items to help you (optional):

^xB97123the best-in-slot weapon you can use is this unique bow: Quill Rain
^7*Make sure to take the mastery that converts % Projectile Speed into % increased Damage once you reach it. 
This cheap bow alone will carry you on easy mode to yellow maps / early red maps. This is a pretty common unique bow!^7

^xB97123Another great unique item you can use during is the: Skirmish quiver.^7
It grants you one additional totem and helps with Intelligence, mana regeneration, and accuracy. Plus, it's a very cheap quiver!

^xB97123Daressos-Defiance body armour (4-link; link it yourself is cheap!)^7
It grants us permanent Onslaught with no downside, since the Hierophant maintains 4 permanent Endurance Charges at all times. 
It also increases the effect of Onslaught by 100%, giving us 40% increased attack speed and movement speed. 
On top of that, it provides high Armour and Evasion, as well as a decent amount of Life.

* I remind you that our damage scales dramatically with Explosive Arrow gem levels. 
As you farm more currency, prioritize getting a level 21/20 Explosive Arrow Skill Gem, an amulet with + to Gem Levels, Gem Level corruptions on your body armour, and a level 4 Empower. (Everything is covered in this guide!)

**Build guide has a lot of useful & esential information like: "COMMON MISTAKES", MAP "REGEX", A GEAR PAGE (with options for budget, normal and maxing the build) etc.

^7_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________^7

Written Build Guide: https://www.poe-vault.com/guides/explosive-arrow-ballista-hierophant-build-guide
